research_method: Instagram (via Railway photo service, degraded: bio/followers/email not visible from this channel) + cross-checked with independent business directories (dogdog.org, floridapetgroomers.com) for rating/address/hours
name: Nery's Grooming
address_note: Also listed under the Carol City neighborhood (part of Miami Gardens) on some directories.
email_note: No public email found after checking IG (bio not reachable via the available Railway photo channel, local Playwright to instagram.com fails from this sandbox), Facebook page, and multiple business directories (dogdog.org, floridapetgroomers.com, chamberofcommerce.com, bizapedia.com). No linktree/poplme in evidence.
reviews_count_note: floridapetgroomers.com shows 5.0 stars / 31 reviews; dogdog.org independently shows '30 people rated this' for the same address/phone. Used 31 (most detailed source). No individual verbatim review text was found on any accessible source (Yelp and Facebook blocked the fetch, aggregator mirrors only expose the aggregate count) despite checking dogdog.org, floridapetgroomers.com, bestprosintown.com (blocked), chamberofcommerce.com (blocked), miamigardens.com listing, cutiepawspedia.com. Site uses the 'razones' (reasons) adapted variant instead of testimonial quotes.
website_candidates_note: All four domain variants failed to resolve/connect (no DNS / connection refused). No website link found on any directory listing (Facebook and Instagram are the only web presence found across 8+ independent aggregator/directory sites).
services_note: No public price list found on any source. Site uses the 'quoted per pet, message us' adapted variant instead of published prices. Handle name '_and_supplies' indicates they also sell grooming/pet supplies in-store.
specialties_observed: Creative color grooming (semi-permanent pet-safe dye, e.g. blue/orange Pomeranian)
photos_source: Instagram feed (@nerysgrooming_and_supplies) via the Railway photo microservice, 12 photos downloaded. Curated down to 8 used: excluded 2 photos with the shop phone number/name baked into the image as text overlay at full size, 1 very dark/low-quality photo with a text overlay, and 1 awkwardly-cropped photo (dog's midsection, not flattering). Two of the 8 used (about section only, never gallery) keep a small brand-name text overlay in the corner; none used in the gallery have baked-in text.
